text: わしの　かわりに　いって　くれんか！

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a verb means someone does something for you. Here くれん is the old-man form of くれない, so it is a polite-ish request. いってくれんか = 'won't you go for me?'

patterns.name: 〜の代わりに
patterns.explanation: かわりに after a person means 'in place of' that person. わしのかわりに = 'in my place'.
